description: This file defines simple-methods used within the OFBiz framework, specifically for order management related operations such as permission checks and updating order statuses.

methods.name: orderAdjustmentPermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to create or edit order adjustments, sets permission flags, and returns appropriate messages.

methods.name: updateOrderStatusFromReceipt
methods.description: Updates the status of an order based on shipment receipt information, marking items and the order as completed when applicable.
